advisory.reason: PR and weekly default-branch CodeQL analysis remain advisory, not part of the required Merge Gate; PR CodeQL failures therefore do not automatically block merge. PR analysis does not immediately update the default-branch alert baseline; the Wednesday scheduled scan normally refreshes it, but delayed, skipped, or failed schedules can extend staleness beyond a week. The required Merge Gate independently aggregates Build/Test/Plugin Verifier/workflow-policy/dependency evidence. Historical Kotlin extractor compatibility was tracked in #114.
